tasks.title: Independent market episode statistics

tasks.title: Strategy promotion evidence framework

tasks.title: Feature whitelist and leakage audit

tasks.title: Multiple-testing and correlation controls
tasks.scope: Add cluster/bootstrap and false-discovery-aware evaluation for hundreds of correlated strategy variants; preserve negative evidence.

tasks.title: Kalshi fee-model audit
tasks.scope: Validate the paper fee approximation and make net rather than gross EV the default research output.

tasks.title: Phase3A action-label quality repair
tasks.scope: Address the known resolved/ambiguous split and non-random missing stop P&L before action ML; document usable/censored/excluded labels.

tasks.title: Phase3B action ML benchmark
tasks.scope: Resume action modeling using chronology-safe data, PASS/no-trade, strict holdouts, calibration and fee/execution-aware metrics.

tasks.title: Settlement probability calibration baseline refresh
tasks.scope: Re-run simple interpretable settlement-probability baselines only as calibration references; preserve the prior failure to robustly beat raw Kalshi unless new evidence changes it.

tasks.title: BTC direction model

tasks.title: BTC magnitude volatility and path models
tasks.scope: Model movement magnitude, volatility/path and threshold-crossing behavior, not just direction.

tasks.title: Regime and change-point detection
tasks.scope: Evaluate rolling/decayed evidence, volatility/momentum/calibration regimes and change-point methods to reduce stale lifetime evidence.

tasks.title: Trade aggressor and microstructure feature layer
tasks.scope: Add/validate aggressor flow, quote velocity, spread, top-book size, order-book imbalance, relative volume and timestamp-safe microstructure features.

tasks.title: Full-depth order-book reconstruction
tasks.scope: Reconstruct full depth prospectively where possible, with price levels, size, partial fills and book state so larger sizing is not modeled as repeated $1 fills.

tasks.title: Timestamp-safe news and event context
tasks.scope: Design external event/news features only when source timestamps and availability can be proven at decision time.

tasks.title: Kalshi repricing and mispricing research

tasks.title: Prospective entry execution-policy experiments
tasks.scope: Prospectively compare STRICT signal-ask IOC, +1 tick, +2 ticks and brief passive policies on fill rate, slippage, missed winners, avoided losers, fees and net P&L.

tasks.title: Fill and slippage prediction model
tasks.scope: Estimate P(fill), fill percentage, entry slippage and time-to-fill from prospective PaperBroker observations.

tasks.title: Meta-selector with PASS action
tasks.scope: Select among sufficiently validated strategies/models using conservative net EV and allow PASS whenever evidence is insufficient.

tasks.title: Expert weighting and contextual selection
tasks.scope: Compare Hedge/exponential weighting, Bayesian model averaging and contextual-bandit-style selection using only matured evidence; keep deep RL deferred.

tasks.title: Frozen challenger and prospective experiment factory

tasks.title: 15-minute boundary jump hypothesis

tasks.title: Late extreme-price hypothesis

tasks.title: EMA VWAP momentum MACD confirmation research
